howPage.title: How it works
howPage.intro: Platform setup, guest onboarding, and daily ops — end to end.

steps.title: Set up the café
steps.body: Name, color, logo, and “X stamps → reward”. SuperAdmin marks the subscription ACTIVE.

steps.title: Register the guest
steps.body: Cashier enters a phone number. The system creates the customer, first stamp, and Wallet invite.

steps.title: Add to Wallet
steps.body: Via SMS (or mock log) the guest saves the pass to Apple or Google Wallet. No app install.

steps.title: Stamp & redeem
steps.body: Each visit adds a stamp; at the threshold the reward is redeemed and the counter resets. Pass syncs.

howPage.opsBody: Cashiers get a single numpad screen. Owners see customers, reports, and café details. SuperAdmins manage tenants.
howPage.imageAlt: Staff registering a guest on a tablet

featuresPage.title: Features
featuresPage.intro: Wallet, SMS, RBAC panel, and reports — enough for a small café.

items.title: Apple & Google Wallet
items.body: Guests don’t install another app. Brand color and logo on the pass.

items.title: SMS invite
items.body: Wallet add link after signup. Mock/log in dev; Netgsm / İletimerkezi ready for prod.

items.title: Staff panel & mobile
items.body: Web admin + Flutter. Cashier counter; owner reports and directory.

items.title: One reward rule
items.body: X stamps = one reward. No VIP tiers — intentional simplicity.

items.title: Reports
items.body: Daily / weekly / monthly stamps & redemptions, near-reward guests, recent activity.

items.title: Turkey first
items.body: TR phone validation, Turkish UI, KVKK copy, local SMS.

pricingPage.title: Pricing
pricingPage.intro: One plan. Manual activation in pilot; online payments (iyzico) on the roadmap.

plans.name: Pilot
plans.note: *Duration and SMS quota per written agreement.

sectorsPage.title: Sectors
sectorsPage.intro: Designed for boutiques with a counter and repeat visits.

items.title: Independent cafés
items.body: 1–3 locations, regulars. The digital version of a paper punch card.

items.title: Specialty coffee
items.body: Reward = free filter or pastry. Brand color shows on the Wallet pass.

items.title: Bakery & pastry
items.body: Fast counter flow; cashier stamps in seconds with a numpad.

items.title: Ice cream & sweets
items.body: Bring seasonal guests back with rewards — no app install.

useCasesPage.title: Use cases
useCasesPage.intro: Happy-path stories from the counter to Wallet.

items.title: First visit → Wallet
items.body: New guest. Cashier enters phone, SMS mock link in logs, guest adds the card. First stamp done.

items.title: Regular stamp
items.body: Search by last digits, select, stamp. 30s idempotency blocks doubles.

items.title: Reward day
items.body: Threshold hit → reward ready. Cashier redeems; counter resets; Wallet syncs.

items.title: Owner morning check
items.body: On mobile or web: stamps, redemptions, near-reward guests, and staff list.

kvkkBody: Dokun & Kazan (“Platform”) acts as data controller under Turkey’s Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK No. 6698).
Data processed: staff email and name; customer phone numbers, stamp/reward records, and Wallet pass identifiers.
Purposes: running the loyalty program, issuing/updating Wallet passes, sending invite SMS, support and security.
Legal bases: performance of a contract, legitimate interest, and explicit consent (for commercial SMS).
Transfers: to SMS and Wallet infrastructure providers only as required to provide the service.
Your rights: you may exercise rights under Article 11 of the Law via our contact channels.
privacyBody: This policy explains how we process data from visitors of our website and the Platform.
We collect: contact-form name, business name, email, phone, and message; short-lived technical logs (IP, browser) for security.
Cookies: essential cookies for session and language; no marketing cookies in the MVP.
Third parties: hosting, SMS, and Wallet services under their service agreements.
Retention: loyalty data while the tenant is active; deletion or anonymization on request within a reasonable time.
termsBody: The Platform is a digital stamp-card SaaS for small businesses. There is no customer mobile app.
Account security is the subscriber’s responsibility; the subscriber manages cashier accounts.
MVP scope: one reward rule, Wallet passes, SMS invite, operations panel. NFC hardware and POS integrations are out of scope.
During pilot, subscriptions may be activated manually; refunds follow written agreement.
Service is provided “as is”; we are not liable for indirect damages from outages or third-party (Apple/Google/SMS) failures.
Turkish law applies; Istanbul courts have jurisdiction.
